name: Peek'n Peak

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate base-area position south of Findley Lake (town of Clymer, Chautauqua County).
Search summary (2026-09-30): base 1,400 ft, top 1,800 ft, vertical 400 ft (converted from feet; Wikipedia rounds to 430 / 550 / 120 m).

weatherPoints.label: Upper Peak, top of the lifts (approx.)

source.note: Search summary (2026-09-30): 130 skiable acres, 8 lifts = 5 triple chairs, 2 double chairs and 1 surface lift, longest run 4,100 ft, 105 in average snowfall (Wikipedia). Trails 27 and 3 progressive terrain parks per the Indy Pass resort page; Wikipedia gives 25 trails and 4 parks.

character: A four-season resort near Clymer and Findley Lake in Chautauqua County, close to Erie, PA, with about 400 ft of vertical, 25–27 trails and 130 acres. Seven chairlifts serve the slopes; the property is marketed as Peek 'n Peak Resort & Spa.
learning: Beginner facilities were not researched (one surface lift is listed) — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Dec 5, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

driveFromIthaca.basis: Estimate from typical routing (NY-13 to Elmira, I-86 W via Corning, Olean and Jamestown to Exit 4 (Findley Lake/Clymer)); not a routing-service result.

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-90 W to Westfield, then south to Findley Lake); not a routing-service result. Erie International (ERI, roughly 45 km) is closer but not in Piste's airport list.
